text:
Leo (Support): Heads up on NovaPay — onboarding stuck, auth errors, customer says they're considering pausing renewal. Need CS help :warning:
Maria (CS): Quick q — what severity and renewal date?
Leo (Support): Renewal 2026-04-30 (about 6 weeks). Severity P1 for NovaPay's QA pipeline — 500s on model endpoint, we rolled back to v1.4 but errors persist. Error sample:
```json
{"error":"kv_cache_mismatch","code":502,"time":"2026-03-20T14:05:12Z"}
```
Also they reported slow responses on batch embed jobs.
Ajay (CSM): I pinged NovaPay last week about SSO; they asked for more help on config. Health score dropped 82 -> 61. This is a clear renewal-risk signal.
Sophia (Enablement): I can join a 30-min enablement call. Wed 3/26 10am PT works for me. @Jordan (Eng) can you join for triage on logs? :calendar:
Jordan (Eng): I can join. Running a quick check — looks like a caching mismatch between dedicated pool and hosted fallback. Quick query I'm running:
`SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE status >= 500 AND customer = 'novapay' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours';`
I'll post numbers shortly.
Leo (Support): FYI we gave a temporary token-rotation workaround. Customer is nervous and asked for a comms plan to their execs.
Maria (CS): Proposed comms steps: 1) Acknowledge incident within 1h 2) Hourly updates until stabilized 3) Executive summary once stable. Owners: Leo (incident updates), Sophia (enablement), Jordan (root cause). Agree? :eyes: 
Ajay (CSM): Agree. Also recommend a usage/credit remediation proposal if outage > 4h.
Sophia (Enablement): I'll run a guided test with their infra and verify SSO. Need dev/sandbox creds — can CS request those?
Maria (CS): Yes, I'll request sandbox creds from acct ops and include legal note. @Leo please share the support bundle (logs + repro).
Leo (Support): Uploading bundle now: https://s3.redwood.internal/novapay/incident-1772405678.zip :lock:
Jordan (Eng): Quick debug: spike traced to KV cache growth + oversubscription on the dedicated pool. Patch queued; can push a canary in ~2h. If canary is good, we'll promote; rollback plan ready.
Ajay (CSM): If canary fails, fallback to hosted-l7 with degraded latency but no 500s — we should agree that as contingency.
Maria (CS): I'll draft the first customer message. Proposed text: "We're aware of intermittent 500s impacting your QA pipeline. Engineering is investigating; a targeted fix will be deployed shortly. We'll provide hourly updates until stable." Thoughts?
Sophia (Enablement): Good start. Add expected next update time and invite them to the enablement call.
Leo (Support): Sent first update at 14:12 PT. Customer replied: "Thank you, please make sure we get exec-level summary if this persists." :eyes:
Maria (CS): Noted. I'll set the calendar for Wed 10am PT and include NovaPay execs + CSMs. Creating CRM flag: "At-Risk: onboarding_friction" for weekly follow-up.
Ajay (CSM): I'll prepare a credit proposal template and share by EOD.
Jordan (Eng): Canary pushed at 16:20 — monitoring shows error rate back to baseline. I'll suppress the alert for 30m to avoid churn, then re-enable and post final status.
Leo (Support): Customer confirms "errors look resolved" at 16:55.
Maria (CS): Closing loop: final comm will include exec summary, remediation steps, and the credit proposal. Postmortem scheduled Fri 3/28 9am PT. Thanks team :handshake:
Sophia (Enablement): I'll run the onboarding checklist during the enablement call.
Ajay (CSM): Marking renewal score update and tracking refund/credit cadence.
Jordan (Eng): I'll prepare a short RCA and paste logs into the postmortem doc.
Maria (CS): Action items recap: Leo — ongoing support updates; Jordan — RCA doc; Sophia — enablement call; Ajay — credit proposal; Maria — customer comms + CRM flags. I'll update the CS playbook with this escalation flow.
Leo (Support): Thanks all :thumbsup:
